name: qwen3-235b-a22b-3gpu
_comment: Qwen3-235B-A22B (235B total, 22B active MoE), UD-Q2_K_XL (~83 GiB on disk) across all three R9700s. --load-mode dio required (P16). WARNING: weights alone leave only ~8-13 GiB of the 96 GiB total for KV-cache + compute buffers across 3 cards -- llama-bench has no explicit context-size flag, ctx is implied by -p/-n per test (640 tok for throughput, ~5120 for thermal), which stays comfortably inside that budget. This is the tightest-fitting model run on this rig so far. FIXED 2026-09-30: tensor split written with '/' (llama-bench syntax) -- the earlier ',' form made llama-bench sweep four values of '1' = everything on GPU 0, which is what failed with 'failed to load model'.
